basis: Conservative inspected half-open semantic spans. Shared helpers are understood for canonical numeric records and the actual table/inequality caller contracts. This does not claim CPU scratch-state, malformed native ABI input or full-firmware completeness.

Eight-byte packed-decimal carry/borrow chains and initial-borrow subtraction variant; prime arithmetic supplies zero initial borrow
Ordinary packed-decimal digit extraction, sign/exponent decode, zero clearing and rejection of nonzero format headers
Ordinary/small/table exponent font selection, sign, tens omission and terminator emission
